# DSH Studio 0.9.8-plus2

The same-site shell: dsh ≥0.1.2 authentication works without patching the harness.

## Fixed and added

- Removed the browser-session exemption (plus1) that bypassed dsh 0.1.2+ token
  authentication for Studio-launched harnesses. The harness is no longer
  modified at install time; its authentication code runs exactly as upstream
  wrote it.
- The shell now serves its own compiled frontend from `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`
  instead of the `tauri://localhost` scheme. Because SameSite treats scheme +
  host (not port) as the "site", the embedded harness iframe is now same-site
  with the shell — the SameSite=Strict session cookie is stored and sent by
  WKWebView exactly as in a browser tab, with no exemption and no proxy.
- Tauri capabilities extended with the official `remote` URL pattern
  (`http://127.0.0.1:*`, `http://localhost:*`) so IPC works from the loopback
  origin.
- Runtime contract schema bumped to 4: previous installs re-qualify on first
  launch, restoring the harness to its unmodified state.

## Verification

- 384 Rust + 269 frontend tests pass; clippy `-D warnings` clean.
- Same-site cookie behaviour verified with a real WKWebView frame against a
  replica of the dsh 0.1.5 auth flow (token → 303 → Strict cookie →
  authenticated session).

## Install

Download the installer for your platform below. The macOS build is universal
and ad-hoc signed: right-click the app and choose Open on first launch. On
Windows, if SmartScreen warns, choose "Run anyway".
